mechanism_gate.basis: Q2 has exactly three value-supported and six risk-armed adaptive traces. The gate requires all supported opportunities, both policies, and value at least tying fallback among risk-armed episodes; mandatory unarmed fallback remains reported separately.

physical_labels.near: no collision and episode minimum clearance <= 0.12 m
physical_labels.safe: no collision and episode minimum clearance > 0.12 m

safety_paths.path_1: A1 has at least one fewer collision+near episode than both A0 and U0, median minimum clearance is no more than 0.005 m worse than either, and task successes are at most one below the best comparator
safety_paths.path_2: A1 danger is no worse than both, median and suite-minimum clearance each exceed both by at least 0.01 m, and task successes are at most one below the best comparator
safety_paths.tie: A1 collision and danger counts equal both comparators and median minimum clearance differs from each by less than 0.01 m

classification.CASE_A: mechanism passes and either frozen safety path passes
classification.CASE_B: mechanism passes and frozen safety tie passes
classification.CASE_C: mechanism passes but neither safety path nor tie passes

selection_boundary: Chosen from Q2 ARM/value/packet timing and runtime only. No evaluator, collision, clearance, completion, progress, or comparative navigation outcome selected this scheduler.
